The '''Mythosaur Hunter's Glaive''' was a type of [[Glaive/Legends|glaive]] used sometime during or after the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="Reveal" />
